description: Search USDA FoodData Central foods by keyword. Returns matching foods with FDC IDs and available preview nutrients: protein (1003), fat (1004), carbohydrate (1005), fiber (1079), and energy (1008, 1062, 2047, 2048), preserving distinct energy estimates. Missing nutrients are omitted. Use the returned fdcId with usda_get_food for other nutrients or the full profile, or usda_compare_foods for side-by-side comparisons. When dataType is omitted, defaults to SR Legacy (common whole foods with complete profiles), to Branded when brandOwner is set (only Branded records carry one), or to Branded and Survey (FNDDS) when the query is 8–14 digits alone (a UPC/GTIN barcode or an FNDDS food code). Set dataType to ["Branded"] for packaged products. Pass brandOwner (e.g. "General Mills") to narrow branded results.

brandOwner.description: Filter branded results by brand owner name (e.g. "General Mills", "Kraft"). Matched as one phrase, ignoring case and punctuation: "Kellogg Company" matches owners holding those words in that order. A value containing * or ? is sent as wildcard terms instead, each word matched on its own (e.g. "Kellog*"). For other operators, use field syntax in query (e.g. "+cereal +brandOwner:Kellog*"). Only Branded records carry one, so setting this defaults dataType to ["Branded"] unless dataType is given explicitly.

dataType.description: FDC data sources to search. Omitting this defaults to ["SR Legacy"] (common whole foods, complete nutrient profiles), to ["Branded"] when brandOwner is set, or to ["Branded", "Survey (FNDDS)"] when the query is 8–14 digits alone (a UPC/GTIN barcode or an FNDDS food code). Include "Branded" for packaged products. Multiple values allowed.

foodCategory.description: Filter by USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products", "Vegetables and Vegetable Products"). Matched as one phrase, ignoring case and punctuation. A value containing * or ? is sent as wildcard terms instead, each word matched on its own (e.g. "Poult*"); a whole word followed by * can match nothing ("Poultry*" does), so shorten it. For other operators, use field syntax in query (e.g. chicken -foodCategory:"Fast Foods" excludes a category).

pageNumber.description: Page number (1-based). Use with totalPages to paginate. FDC serves only the first 100,000 results of a search, so a page whose pageSize × pageNumber exceeds 100,000 fails with result_window_exceeded, naming the last reachable page, unless it is also past the last page. A page past the last returns empty foods with a notice naming the last reachable page when the query has matches.

pageSize.description: Number of results per page. Default 10, maximum 50.

query.description: Search terms — food name, ingredient, or UPC/GTIN code. Examples: "chicken breast raw", "banana", "02114029705". A food matching any one unqualified word counts, so a multi-word query also returns foods holding only some of its words; set requireAllWords, or prefix each word with +, to require them all. A query of 8–14 digits alone matches a Branded UPC/GTIN code exactly as FDC stores it, leading zeros included, or an 8-digit Survey (FNDDS) food code. FDC reads Lucene syntax: "quoted phrases", +required and -excluded terms, AND/OR/NOT, wildcards (chick*), fuzzy matches (beeef~), boosts (beef^5), grouping parentheses, field:value, regex terms (/chick.*/), and ranges ([a TO c], {a TO c}). Any other slash, bracket, or brace (1/8, w/o, beef [raw]), any unpaired parenthesis, and every double quote when the query holds an odd number of them are sent as literal characters.

requireAllWords.description: Match only foods containing every query word (FDC requireAllWords). Default false: a food matching any one word counts. Explicit OR and "quoted phrases" keep their meaning.

name: usda_search_foods

currentPage.description: Current page number (1-based); the requested page for exhausted pages.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `query_empty`: The query is empty or contains only whitespace. `query_syntax`: FDC rejected the query syntax, e.g. a dangling operator or a trailing backslash. `no_results`: No foods matched the query in the specified data sources. `result_window_exceeded`: pageSize × pageNumber exceeds the first 100,000 results FDC serves for a search, on a page that holds matches. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A food item matching the search query.

basisUnit.description: What the nutrient amounts are per 100 of: "g" for every non-Branded food and for Branded labels in g, GRM, or GM; "ml" for Branded labels in ml or MLT. Absent when the Branded label unit (e.g. IU, MG), or its absence, fixes neither: the amounts are then per 100 label units, basis unverified.

brandName.description: Brand name. Present for Branded items only.

brandOwner.description: Brand owner name. Present for Branded items only.

dataType.description: FDC data source: SR Legacy, Foundation, Survey (FNDDS), or Branded.

description.description: USDA food description (e.g. "Chicken, broilers or fryers, breast, meat only, raw").

fdcId.description: FDC ID — pass to usda_get_food, usda_get_foods, or usda_compare_foods.

foodCategory.description: USDA food category (e.g. "Poultry Products"). Absent for some branded items.

gtinUpc.description: UPC/GTIN barcode as FDC stores it, leading zeros kept (e.g. "02114029705"). Branded only; a query of exactly these digits finds the product again.

householdServingFullText.description: Serving description as it appears on the label (e.g. "1 cup", "1 oz"). Branded only.

nutrients.description: Available preview nutrients on the food's per-100 basis (basisUnit): protein (1003), fat (1004), carbohydrate (1005), fiber (1079), and energy (1008, 1062, 2047, 2048). Source order, values and distinct energy estimates are preserved. Missing entries are omitted; use usda_get_food for other nutrients.

items.description: A preview nutrient entry with ID, name, and amount on the food's per-100 basis (basisUnit).

amount.description: Amount per 100 g, per 100 ml when basisUnit is "ml", or per 100 label units when basisUnit is absent.

publishedDate.description: Date the food entry was published in FDC.

servingSize.description: Serving size from the product label, in servingSizeUnit. Branded only.

servingSizeUnit.description: Unit for servingSize as FDC reports it (e.g. "GRM", "MLT", "IU"); it sets basisUnit. Branded only.

notice.description: Guidance when the requested page is past the last reachable page, or when more foods match than the first 100,000 FDC serves.

totalCount.description: Total foods matching the query across all pages.

totalHits.description: Total number of foods matching the query across all pages.

totalPages.description: Total number of pages at this pageSize, as FDC counts them. FDC serves only the first 100,000 results of a search, so when totalHits exceeds 100,000, pages past 100,000 / pageSize (rounded down) are out of reach.

title: Search USDA Foods
